captureGap.reasonForNoRetry: Original terminal endpoints remain single-attempt; no repeated requests used to fill the observer gap.

limits: All five original packaged platform logs and compact failure proofs were already captured before this aggregate observer failure. Their failures/cleanup scopes remain unchanged.
The complete canonical jobs page is retained, including all seven original job results and steps. It is never queried again.
No manual rerun, dispatch, cancellation, native/app/build/test process or source change was used.
This is an observer evidence gap, not a product test PASS or a claim that the remote requests failed.
